s: prophets and priests (of Jerusalem) has sin shed the blood of the just (cause of Jerusalem's fall)
q: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.

s: prophets and priests (of Jerusalem) has state polluted with blood (wander as blind men)
q: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.

s: LORD remains forever
q: You, LORD, remain forever.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) has given hands to Assyrians (to be satisfied with bread)
q: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) bears sin and iniquity (fathers' iniquities)
q: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

s: fathers (our fathers) committed sin and iniquity (no longer living)
q: Our fathers sinned, and are no more.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) is ruled by servants (who rule over us) (no deliverer)
q: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) has skin black like an oven (due to famine)
q: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) has lost joy (dance turned into mourning)
q: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) has fallen crown (fallen from head)
q: The crown has fallen from our head.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) has committed sin and iniquity (confessed)
q: Woe to us, for we have sinned!

s: speakers (the lamenting community) asks to be turned by LORD (prayer for renewal)
q: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.

s: Zion is desolate (mountain of Zion)
q: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

s: LORD has throne from generation to generation (duration)
q: Your throne is from generation to generation.

s: foxes (on Zion) walk on Zion
q: The foxes walk on it.

s: women and virgins (of Zion and Judah) were ravished in Zion (women in Zion)
q: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.

s: LORD is angry against speakers (the lamenting community) (very angry)
q: You are very angry against us.

s: LORD has rejected speakers (the lamenting community) (utterly)
q: But you have utterly rejected us.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) has inheritance held by strangers and aliens (inheritance turned over)
q: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) is orphans and fatherless (mothers are as widows)
q: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) must pay for water and wood (purchased)
q: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) is pursued by adversary and enemy (of Jerusalem) (weary, without rest)
q: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.

s: speakers (the lamenting community) has given hands to Egyptians (to be satisfied with bread)
q: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

Joshua is a son of Nun
q: the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

s: LORD is with Joshua (as he was with Moses; will not fail or forsake him)
q: As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

s: LORD is god of children of Israel
q: for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

s: LORD swore to give land to fathers of Israel
q: the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

s: promised land (land given to Israel) has border Euphrates (eastern boundary, the great river)
q: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

s: promised land (land given to Israel) has border great sea (western boundary toward the going down of the sun)
q: and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

s: promised land (land given to Israel) includes land of the Hittites
q: the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

s: promised land (land given to Israel) has border Lebanon (northern boundary)
q: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates

s: promised land (land given to Israel) has border wilderness (southern boundary)
q: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river

s: book of the law of Moses commanded by Moses (law Moses commanded Joshua)
q: according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you.

s: Joshua is servant of Moses
q: the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

s: book of the law of Moses must not depart from Joshua (his mouth; to meditate on day and night)
q: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night

s: Reubenites possesses land land beyond the Jordan (given by Moses)
q: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan

s: Gadites possesses land land beyond the Jordan (given by Moses)
q: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan

s: half-tribe of Manasseh possesses land land beyond the Jordan (given by Moses)
q: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan

s: Reubenites obeys Joshua (pledged to listen as they did to Moses)
q: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you.

s: Gadites obeys Joshua (pledged to listen as they did to Moses)
q: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you.
